title: Recipe collections
description: Ordered collections of recipes. Each collection teaches one feature end to end; its recipes are listed in learning-path order. Collection order is display order.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. The developer site uses it as the collection's anchor on the Cookbook index.

label.description: Display name. Match the developer-site guide section for the same feature where one exists.

description.description: One sentence describing what the collection's recipes build, in order.

recipes.description: Recipe ids in learning-path order: the first recipe is the starting point.
